algorithm: {The algorithm prioritizes bins with the highest remaining capacity relative to the item size, favoring bins that can accommodate the item without excessive leftover space, while penalizing bins that are already nearly full or cannot fit the item at all.}
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - np.minimum(bins, item)
    # Avoid division by zero and ensure non-negative values
    safe_remaining = np.where(remaining > 0, remaining, 1e-9)
    # Prioritize bins with higher remaining capacity relative to item size
    # Penalize bins that are too small to fit the item
    priorities = np.where(item > bins, 0, 1 / (safe_remaining + 1e-9))
    return priorities
